text:
Marta: Random idea  pretzel bake-off at the office kitchen next Thursday, then ping-pong doubles in the rec room? small prizes, bragging rights. :pretzel: :trophy:
Ethan: i'm IN. can we do a beginner track for people who only microwave? lol.
Jia: love it. is there space for proofing dough? timewise?
Marta: thinking 6pm start for dough prep, bake at 6:45, ping-pong at 7:30. should fit in after hours.
Felix: i can bring a dough hook and extra bowls. also happy to referee the ping-pong bracket.
Harper: any gluten-free option? i can't eat wheat.
Jia: we could do a seeded focaccia alternative? not a pretzel but still bake-y. label clearly.
Marta: good call. we'll make 2 tracks: classic pretzel and GF roll. both judged for texture + creativity.
Ethan: what are prizes? stickers? coffee shop gift card?
Felix: small gift card for winner + custom sticker pack. cheap but fun.
Marta: BakeBot can we run a quick RSVP + skill poll (baker / beginner / spectator)?
BakeBot: Poll created: "Pretzel night RSVP & skill" Options: Baker (bringing supplies), Beginner (needs guidance), Spectator. Link: https://bakebot.example/polls/pretzel2051
Harper: RSVP Spectator. thanks for GF option.
Jia: Baker here. i'll bring baking soda for the lye bath substitute and extra oven mitts.
Ethan: Beginner. i'll bring a bag of pretzel salt.
Felix: Baker. also can we cap at 12 people? kitchen space is limited.
Marta: yes cap 12. first 12 to RSVP. also budget: let's do $8 contribution to cover ingredients and prize. ok? :moneybag:
Harper: $8 sounds fine.
Jia: works for me. can someone add this to the events calendar?
Marta: i'll create the calendar invite now and include a short prep list. link: https://calendar.example/event/pretzel-bakeoff
Ethan: who wants to be my ping-pong partner? i'm left-handed, wild spin. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
Felix: i'll partner with you. liaison for brackets.
Marta: perfect. i'll post a sign-up sheet for partners and note allergy labels (nuts/soy).
BakeBot: Calendar event created and RSVP link posted in the invite. Note: $8 suggested contribution; GF track included.
Marta: thanks team! any volunteers to bring aprons and cleanup crew?
Jia: cleanup duty here, happy to help.
Ethan: i'll bring aprons. see you next Thursday! :sparkles:
